definitions.assessment: Use private food at collection after border trade. Taxable surplus is stock above the protected floor. Classify zero assessment by floor first, then full warehouse, then zero normal integer cap (min(surplus//16,population//64)); this last condition does not preclude an authorized supplemental levy. Remaining zero assessments have no assigned cause.
definitions.concessions: Count concessions and refusal only from postings against an actual assessment. Positive net collections can still have partial concessions and refusals, included in amounts.
definitions.extra_views: Deposited inflow and after-deposit outflow both exclude levy handling. Memo fields for freight components, net tax, aid, and shipment receipts overlap the parent totals.
definitions.internal_transfers: Inter-depot and foreign aid dispatch/receipt stay in world public custody. Only aid loss and actual freight leave it. Domestic relief and household issues enter private custody.
definitions.tax_coverage: A only, 32 regions each year. Gross collection is positive even if entirely spent on handling. Net deposit is after handling. Zero harvest can coexist with taxable previously held or traded food.
definitions.units: All amounts in simulated food units. Flows are period sums or per simulated world-year. Stocks are measured once per world at each interval boundary.
